meta.title: Strategy registry — specs, validation gates, and leaderboard tiers
meta.purpose: Define strategies precisely enough that they can be graded, and block any strategy that cannot be graded instead of pretending it works.
meta.grading_status: 0 strategies have graded results. Every row below is a SPEC, not a track record. The leaderboard is live and will populate as weeks are captured.
meta.honesty_rule: A strategy may be shown as 'passes gates' only if the script that grades it runs on stored data. Otherwise it is 'blocked' with the missing input named.

gates.name: Source traceable
gates.test: Every input field maps to a URL under nfl.com or operations.nfl.com, stored in data/sources.json.

gates.name: Sample sufficiency
gates.test: At least 30 independent observations before any hit rate is quoted, and at least 10 per parameter estimated.
gates.fail_action: Shown as 'insufficient evidence' with the current n.

gates.name: Luck separation
gates.test: Strategy P&L must not be explained by Pythagorean luck of the clubs it backs: leave-one-luck-decile-out must keep the sign of the edge.
gates.fail_action: Strategy is demoted to 'luck-driven' and cannot reach Contender.

gates.name: Correlation declared
gates.test: Every leg in a parlay/prop combo has its shared driver listed in data/correlations.json; the largest unmeasured term sets the haircut.

gates.name: Ex-ante definition
gates.test: The rule must be fully specified before the games it is graded on; no parameter may be chosen after seeing results.
gates.fail_action: Strategy is flagged as overfit and cannot be graded.

gates.name: Price beatable
gates.test: Strategy must beat the available price by more than the declared edge threshold after any vig.
gates.fail_action: Cannot reach Champion. BLOCKED IN v0: no licensed odds feed (flag F07).

gates.name: Stability
gates.test: Leave-one-club-out and leave-one-week-out must both keep the sign of the edge.
gates.fail_action: Edge is attributed to a single club/week and marked fragile.

gates.name: Reproducible
gates.test: A script in scripts/ recomputes the strategy's signal from stored data with no manual steps.
gates.fail_action: Strategy is not allowed on the leaderboard.

tiers.name: Blocked
tiers.requirement: Fails G1 or G8, or a required input does not exist.

tiers.name: Explorer
tiers.requirement: Passes G1, G2-definition and G8; signal computable but not yet graded on results.
tiers.reward: Entry on the board, no ranking credit

tiers.name: Contender
tiers.requirement: Passes G1–G5, G7, G8 with >=30 graded observations and live results.

tiers.name: Champion
tiers.requirement: Contender plus G6: measurable positive edge over a verifiable price.
tiers.reward: Top of board; eligible for the season reward pool weighting

tiers.name: Proven
tiers.requirement: Champion plus an out-of-sample repeat in a later season with stable closing-line value.

scoring.formula: score = sum over graded bets of (result x weight) / sqrt(n), with weight = declared edge / declared sigma, then divided by the largest unmeasured correlation haircut on the ticket.
scoring.why_sqrt_n: Stops a strategy from winning by volume alone. It must win per unit of evidence, not per unit of action.
scoring.luck_penalty: Any strategy whose graded P&L has |correlation with club luck_wins| > 0.30 has its score multiplied by 0.5 and is labelled luck-exposed.
scoring.minimum_to_rank: 30 graded bets and at least 3 distinct weeks.
scoring.no_bet_is_a_bet: A strategy that abstains is scored as a no-op, not as a win. Coverage is reported separately so abstention cannot be hidden.

strategies.name: Margin trend, neutral-line filter
strategies.thesis: Point differential per game is the best single predictor of win percentage we can verify (COR-01, r=0.878). When our originated line sits at least 1.5 points away from a neutral 3-point home line in the direction of the margin gap, the side is worth grading.
strategies.mechanism: signal = (shrunk rating gap) - 1.9 HFA; bet the side whose originated spread is >= 1.5 points beyond the neutral line.
strategies.evidence: r=0.8781 (n=32) supports the input. No graded bets yet.
strategies.caveat: A rating built from league aggregates cannot see opponent strength. It will misprice clubs with extreme schedules.

strategies.name: Total anchor, extreme-total fade
strategies.thesis: Extreme originated totals compress toward the league mean more than they expand. Play under when the originated total is in the top decile of the season's originated totals and over when in the bottom decile.
strategies.mechanism: z = (total - mean(originated totals)) / sd(originated totals); act when |z| >= 1.2.
strategies.evidence: Only 14 originated totals exist. Far below the 30-observation floor.
strategies.caveat: Mean reversion in totals is a claim about market behaviour, and we hold no market data. This cannot be validated without a price.

strategies.name: Availability gap
strategies.thesis: When one club's capped offensive availability penalty exceeds the opponent's by 1.5 points, fade the depleted club.
strategies.evidence: Signal computable for all 28 clubs on the Week 10 slate.
strategies.caveat: Magnitude is a declared constant, not measured. The injury table also misses cases like BAL QB (flag F02), so this signal is incomplete by construction.

strategies.name: Luck fade
strategies.thesis: Clubs in the top quartile of Pythagorean luck_wins are priced on wins that scoring margin does not support. Fade them; back the bottom quartile.
strategies.mechanism: rank clubs by luck_wins (data/luck.json); act on games involving rank <= 8 or rank >= 25.
strategies.evidence: Luck is measured for all 32 clubs. Range is +2.17 (DEN) to -2.17 (TB).
strategies.caveat: By construction this strategy is a bet on luck, which fails the spirit of G3. It is kept on the board as the counter-example the luck filter exists to catch.

strategies.name: Two-leg cross-game correlation parlay
strategies.thesis: Cross-game legs are structurally independent (COR-A5), so the joint probability is the product. The only adjustment needed is for league-wide scoring shocks.
strategies.mechanism: pick 2 legs from different games with pick_confidence >= 0.25; price at p1*p2*(1 - haircut); haircut = 0.05.
strategies.evidence: Independence is structural, not statistical — a stronger claim than a measured r.
strategies.caveat: Structural independence does not create edge. A parlay of two coin flips is still a coin flip.

strategies.name: QB + WR shared-driver prop stack
strategies.thesis: QB passing yards and his WR's receiving yards share targets (COR-A4). The stack should be PRICED as one event, not two.
strategies.evidence: Blocked. Direction of the correlation is certain from mechanism; the size is not measured.
strategies.caveat: This is the most common way prop bettors lose money: they stack two legs of the same event and treat them as independent.

strategies.name: Division underdog
strategies.thesis: Divisional underdogs are said to outperform because familiarity compresses margins.
strategies.mechanism: requires per-game results with division flags.
inputs: MISSING: game-by-game results with division labels
strategies.evidence: Blocked. The standings table gives division records but not per-game margins.
strategies.caveat: Popular belief is not evidence. This stays blocked until game-level data exists.

strategies.name: Specialist blind spot
strategies.thesis: A club missing its kicker or punter loses hidden points that the standings table never shows. Weight ST absences at 2-3x the per-player penalty.
strategies.mechanism: st penalty capped at 1.0 point per club; act when the ST gap >= 0.6.
strategies.evidence: Week 10 has two relevant absences: TEN P Tommy Townsend (Knee, Achilles) and GB K Trey Smack is full participation.
strategies.caveat: Small effect sizes. With a 1.0-point cap this cannot move a line much, which is intentional.

leaderboard.why_empty: Grading requires completed games plus a stored pre-game line snapshot for each week. Only Week 10 is captured, and 13 of its 14 games have not been played as of 2026-11-14.
what_unlocks_it: capture each week's originated lines BEFORE kickoff (CI job, Monday 00:00 UTC)
capture final scores from an official NFL source after the week ends
grade every active strategy automatically in the same job
never edit a line snapshot after the fact — the file's git history is the audit trail
leaderboard.reward_pool_rule: Rewards are allocated only to tier 3 and tier 4 strategies, in proportion to sqrt(n)-normalised score. A strategy that cannot beat a verifiable price earns nothing, no matter how good the narrative.
